blocks.text: Day 10 · Breakfast. Excursion to the Argentine side of the falls. From the visitor centre, the ecological jungle train crosses the Misiones rainforest to the Garganta del Diablo station, where the walkway leads to one of Argentina’s most impressive sights, the Devil’s Throat. Continue to the Cataratas station for the Upper Walk or the Lower Walk, which reveal the falls from other angles. The visit ends with a cultural immersion in the yerba mate tradition at the Yabuticaba Rainforest Market. Return to the hotel. Recommended at an additional cost: “The Great Adventure” (see Optional Excursions).
